senses.gloss:
(I)--a species of white elephants with four tusks;
1: भा., X. ५९. ३७.
the elephant of Indra.
2: Vi. I. 9. 7, २५; २२. 5.
Lord of elephants; travelling in the sun's chariot during the month of कार्तिक;
3: Vi. II. १०. १२.
Indra rode on, to see कृष्ण;
4: Vi. V. १२. 2. १३ and २५; २९. 1.
defeated by गरुड in a fight between कृष्ण and Indra.
5: Vi. V. ३०. ६६.
[page१-282+ ३८]
